title: enactic/openarm
abstract:
A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments.

# OpenArm **OpenArm** is an open-source 7DOF humanoid arm designed for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments. With high backdrivability and compliance, it is built with safe human-robot interaction in mind while delivering practical payload capabilities for real-world applications. **OpenArm Cell** (on the right) is a standardized environment with unified background, lighting, and camera placement. Research performed using OpenArm can be reproduced around the world in consistent evaluation conditions, facilitating the global discussion on state of the art physical AI research. OpenArm features **human-scale** proportions, safety and compliance, and practical payloads. At $6,500 USD for a complete bimanual system, it provides a flexible platform for teleoperation, imitation learning, simulation, and real-world data collection in contact-rich tasks. *We're in continuous development and actively seeking contributors, research partners, and company collaborators to shape the next generation of practical humanoid systems. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出并开源 OpenArm：一款 7 自由度、人形尺度、高背驱动性与柔顺性的机械臂，配套标准化的 OpenArm Cell 统一背景/光照/相机布局，并以 6,500 美元提供完整双臂系统用于遥操作、模仿学习、仿真与真实数据采集。


# 一、动机

> 面向 contact-rich 环境的物理 AI 研究常受限于硬件闭源、价格高昂、实验条件不统一，导致工作难以在全球范围内复现与横向对比。


# 二、方法

> 提出并开源 OpenArm：一款 7 自由度、人形尺度、高背驱动性与柔顺性的机械臂，配套标准化的 OpenArm Cell 统一背景/光照/相机布局，并以 6,500 美元提供完整双臂系统用于遥操作、模仿学习、仿真与真实数据采集。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 1) 单臂 7DOF，完整双臂系统售价 6,500 美元，具备高背驱动性与柔顺性以支持安全人机交互；2) OpenArm Cell 通过统一背景、光照与相机位姿，使全球研究者在一致条件下评估，提升可复现性；3) 官方同步开源硬件、文档与社区渠道（GitHub/Discord），面向 contact-rich 任务提供遥操作与数据采集平台。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：目前以硬件与生态建设为主，摘要未给出具体任务成功率或学习性能数字，柔顺性与精度需在真实实验中验证；启发：低成本开源硬件＋标准化采集环境（统一相机与光照）可显著降低具身智能数据采集与跨机构复现门槛，适合作为遥操作/模仿学习的数据基础设施。
